the checkpoints and runs only the missing phases

Why the guard

what the agent sends leaves the

No Web IQ key: no web tools.

tr.td: The advisor (or the analyst) signs in with Microsoft Entra ID (MSAL) and chats in the React app.
The browser calls the chat UI API on Azure Container Apps with the user's token (scope access_as_user).
The API exchanges the token on behalf of the user, streams the hosted agent's Responses endpoint, and keeps sessions and run activity in Cosmos DB.
The harness calls gpt-5.6-luna in Foundry Models; a blocking content-safety guardrail filters prompts and completions.
Client memory, preferences, conversation history and meeting-pack checkpoints live in the user-isolated durable state store.
Every Microsoft IQ call goes through a Foundry toolbox (MCP) with the caller's context.
Work IQ MCP runs as the user under the tenant's Work IQ policy: retrieval, Graph reads, ask, and Copilot agents through ask (agentId).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1302px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1709px; margin-left: 1340px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1B1B1B;
display: inline-block; font-size: 15px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #1B1B1B; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

tr.td: Work IQ Chat over A2A answers a whole delegated question as one A2A task (one task per call).
Fabric IQ: the Portfolio Analyst data agent queries the portfolio lakehouse as the user.
Foundry IQ: the firm-knowledge knowledge base returns the policy sections the agent cites, as the project's managed identity.
Web IQ: the BoundaryGuard blocks client data first; only public topics leave the boundary (API key).
The only write: after the advisor approves, Work IQ create_entity saves a draft in Outlook Drafts. Nothing is sent.
Quality loop: Insights and evaluations feed the agent optimizer; a leakage guard rejects overfit candidates; the candidate agent is promoted only if it wins.
The chat UI's source viewer opens cited emails, events, chats and files through Microsoft Graph as the user.

Not drawn: OpenTelemetry export to Application Insights (and Agent 365 where the tenant has it), managed-identity token requests, image pulls from the registry.
